purpose: Linux native tempo software pre-admission research

frozen.current_tool_changes_after_execution: README result text only; four executable tool sources match prepared-v1

configuration.certainty: unmodified native histogram-bin value, not a probability
configuration.coordinate: consumed PCM frames, not event positions

input_identity.verification: each PCM checked against old SHA before and after native calls and after each matrix

reference.source: unchanged beat_seconds and reference_beat_unit in frozen metadata
reference.bpm: 60*48000/(end-start), interval mean, not an exact instantaneous tempo
reference.silent_channels: original silent_channels has no scalar reference
reference.outside_intervals: unscored, not inferred silence or missing beats
reference.six_eight: original dotted_quarter unit, no harmonic correction

execution.rss_scope: RUSAGE_CHILDREN high-water since each runner start; not a separate peak for each driver

observations.non_silent_reference_coverage: 34/34 records have coverage 1 after warmup inside original adjacent-beat intervals
observations.silent_channels: 6/6 records have zero nonzero BPM readings
observations.six_eight: original dotted-quarter BPM reference only, not meter recognition
observations.stale_after_audio: NOT_RUN: original non-silent tails have insufficient exact-zero history; no tail appended

product_integration: none; no Python backend, production FFI/dependencies, Cargo or schema changes
